name: craftable
title: New craftable
summary: A new item that a player crafts from two vanilla items: its config class, a crafting recipe in script, the recipe registered with the vanilla recipe manager, and a loot entry.

parent.help: Vanilla class the new item inherits

scripts.why: Base class of the new recipe.
The method the modded manager overrides, calling super first.
A vanilla two ingredient recipe to mirror.

classes.name: {item}
classes.notes: scope 2, with its own model, itemSize and weight.

classes.name: PluginRecipesManager
classes.notes: Overrides RegisterRecipies(), calls super, then RegisterRecipe(new Craft_{item}).

files.what: Add {parent_addon} to requiredAddons[] and the {item} class to CfgVehicles. CfgMods must list scripts/4_World.
The modded PluginRecipesManager that registers it.

tasks.task: Add class {item} : {parent} to CfgVehicles with scope 2, displayName, descriptionShort, model, itemSize and weight. Add {parent_addon} to requiredAddons[]. Make sure CfgMods lists scripts/4_World.
Make or pick the model for {item} and its texture, or reuse a vanilla model if the user agrees.
tasks.done: /dayz-p3d-audit passes on the model, and the model path in config.cpp exists.

tasks.task: Write Craft_{item} extends RecipeBase, mirroring CraftRagRope: ingredient 0 {ingredient1}, ingredient 1 {ingredient2}, result {item}. Register it in a modded PluginRecipesManager that overrides RegisterRecipies(), calls super.RegisterRecipies(), then RegisterRecipe(new Craft_{item}).
tasks.done: /dayz-lint {mod} passes and the modded class has no extends clause.

tasks.task: Add a types.xml entry for {item} with /dayz-edit-types. Use nominal 0 if it is only crafted.
tasks.done: The entry exists and min is not above nominal.

checks.feature: The crafted item exists in the world
A player can hold the crafted item

needs_person: The craft itself: combine {ingredient1} and {ingredient2} in game and check that {item} appears and the ingredients are used up. The gate has no craft action.
questions: What display name and description should the item have?
What should crafting use up: all of both ingredients, or part of a stack?
Should it also spawn as loot, or only be crafted?
A new model, or a vanilla model to start with?
